test.title: How a tram line was saved

paragraphs.text: In 2010 the city council planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen. A group of residents collected 20,000 signatures against the closure, and the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year. During that year, new timetables and cheaper tickets increased passenger numbers by forty per cent, and the line was kept.
paragraphs.label: A

document.title: How a tram line was saved

items.quote: the city council planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen
items.prompt: The council’s plan to close the tram line

explanation.en: The plan to close the line came “because passenger numbers had fallen” → B. A is also about passengers, but it is the trial’s result, not the reason for the plan.
explanation.kk: Жолды жабу жоспары «because passenger numbers had fallen» пайда болған → B. A да жолаушылар туралы, бірақ бұл жоспардың себебі емес, сынақтың нәтижесі.
explanation.ru: План закрыть линию возник, «because passenger numbers had fallen» → B. A тоже про пассажиров, но это итог испытания, а не причина плана.

items.quote: the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year

explanation.en: “keep the line for a trial year” — the trial lasted one year → E.
explanation.kk: «keep the line for a trial year» — сынақ бір жылға созылған → E. «Period» — «year» дегенді басқаша айтады.
explanation.ru: «keep the line for a trial year» — испытание длилось год → E. «Period» пересказывает «year».

options.text: was kept because passenger numbers rose.
was made because too few people were using the line.
was organised by local bus companies.
was cancelled because tickets were too expensive.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A–E, from the box below.

steps.en: Read the beginning: “The council’s plan to close the tram line”. We need an ending that continues it in meaning and grammar.
steps.kk: Басын оқимыз: «The council’s plan to close the tram line». Мағынасы мен грамматикасы жағынан жалғастыратын соңы керек.
steps.ru: Читаем начало: «The council’s plan to close the tram line». Нужно окончание, которое по смыслу и грамматике продолжает его.

steps.en: The text: the council “planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen”.
steps.kk: Мәтінде: әкімдік «planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen».
steps.ru: В тексте: совет «planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen».

steps.en: B fits: the plan came because few people used the line. A, about rising numbers, is the end of the story → B.
steps.kk: B сай келеді: жоспар жолмен аз адам жүргендіктен болған. A жолаушының көбеюі туралы — бұл оқиғаның соңы → B.
steps.ru: Подходит B: план был, потому что линией пользовались мало. A про рост пассажиров — это конец истории → B.

steps.en: Beginning: “The trial period”. Compare the endings with what the text says about the trial.
steps.kk: Басы «The trial period». Соңғы бөліктерді мәтінде сынақ туралы айтылғанмен салыстырамыз.
steps.ru: Начало «The trial period». Окончания сравниваем с тем, что текст говорит об испытании.

steps.en: “the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year” — the trial lasted a year.
steps.kk: «the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year» — сынақ мерзімі бір жыл.
steps.ru: «the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year» — срок испытания один год.

steps.en: The answer is E. The extra endings C and D are not supported by the text.
steps.kk: Жауап — E. Артық C мен D мәтінде расталмайды.
steps.ru: Ответ E. Лишние окончания C и D не подтверждаются текстом.
